note: Both sets have exactly 12 entries — label COUNT is held constant so only label CONTENT varies (GLINER-QUERY-VOCAB-v2 measured severe multi-label dilution). Descriptive labels use the 'Type: description' form because the GLiNER sidecar already maps a proposal back to its canonical type via label.split(':',1)[0] — so this format is production-compatible with no code change.

descriptive.Person: Person: a specifically identifiable named individual person
descriptive.Organization: Organization: a specifically identifiable company, agency, institution, team, or named organization
descriptive.Location: Location: a specifically identifiable place, city, region, country, facility, or named site
descriptive.Product: Product: a specifically identifiable commercial product, application, service, or named offering
descriptive.Technology: Technology: a specifically identifiable technology, protocol, algorithm, standard, framework, or technical system
descriptive.Concept: Concept: a specifically identifiable abstract concept, principle, theory, or named idea
descriptive.Method: Method: a specifically identifiable method, technique, procedure, strategy, or named approach
descriptive.Event: Event: a specifically identifiable event, incident, outage, milestone, or named occurrence
descriptive.Document: Document: a specifically identifiable document, report, record, dataset, or named written artifact
descriptive.Process: Process: a specifically identifiable process, workflow, operation, or named ongoing activity
descriptive.Measurement: Measurement: a specifically identifiable measurement, metric, quantity, or named unit of measure
descriptive.TimeReference: TimeReference: a specifically identifiable date, time, period, or named temporal reference
